title: Billing guidance
body: Duplicate charges, invoices, receipts, declined payments, delayed refunds, and being billed twice belong to Billing. Refunds usually take five to ten business days after approval. Billing should investigate the refund reference after ten business days. A delayed refund does not imply a product outage.

title: Account access guidance
body: Password resets, sign-in, MFA, authenticator recovery, member roles, permissions, invitations and suspected account compromise belong to Account & Access.

title: Technical guidance
body: Errors, crashes, failed exports, slow dashboards, webhook timeouts, service outages and unavailable services belong to Technical Issue.

title: Feature guidance
body: Requests for future functionality, dark mode, scheduled exports, custom reports and new integrations belong to Feature Request.

title: General guidance
body: Questions about getting started, onboarding, tutorials, documentation, supported browsers, storage limits and file-size limits belong to General Inquiry.

title: Urgency policy
body: A future optional feature request has low priority. A routine question, delayed refund or issue with a working alternative has normal priority. A work-blocking issue with no workaround has high priority. Suspected account compromise or a service outage affecting all users has urgent priority. Negated impact such as no account compromise is not evidence of an urgent issue. If a request is unrelated to this support knowledge or has two equally dominant categories, abstain for human review.
